test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 20 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper sells two articles at a ₹840 each. He earns a 20% profit on the first article and incurs a 20% loss on the second article. Determine the percentage of net profit or loss he incurs.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price of each article = ₹840

Profit on first article = 20%

Loss on second article = 20%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = dfrac{Selling Price}{1 + Profit\%/100} for profit

Cost Price (CP) = dfrac{Selling Price}{1 - Loss\%/100} for loss

**Calculations:**

CP of first article = dfrac{840}{1 + 20/100}<
